Method of Attack: Stealing Instagram credentials by asking users to log in with Instagram credentials and secretly collecting username and password
Uploading stolen credentials to a remote server in cleartext
Using stolen credentials to take over accounts and post image ads
Extorting account owners for large sums of money
Impacted Systems: Android apps on Google Play Store
Attack Vector: Malicious Android apps installed from Google Play Store that request Instagram login credentials
Date of Discovery: Not explicitly dated for the recent Turkish apps but implied recent
